info.name: TigerCS <-> Queueing System - Receiving API
info.description: The eight events the Queueing System sends to TigerCS (POST /api/integrations/queueing/events). Set baseUrl and apiKey (never commit the key) and the mapped ids in the environment. Folder 2 is one queue ticket's whole life: run it top to bottom - the collection generates the EventId, ExternalTicketId, sequence and timestamps as it goes.
